structured.answer: At 500 ₪ a month, if I take it out after 8 years I'd have about 68,853 ₪ in hand, from 48,000 ₪ I put in. For 4 years the calculator gave me nothing for עצמאים ("עוד אין כאן חישוב"), only a 25,725 next to an empty box, which seems to be the same money in a regular securities account, not the fund.

stuck.why: The bar was an empty dashed box, the orange text said there's no calculation for withdrawing before 6 years, and there was a lone number, 25,725, over it. At first I thought that was my amount after 4 years.
The page moved around (fields jumped up and sideways), so for a second I wasn't sure what I was looking at.
